modules.title: TotemCore
modules.description: Shared APIs, unified manuals, exact client/server version checks, events, and legacy ID migration for the Totem ecosystem.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemCore 0.6.0 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds first-join guided manual onboarding, gated module progression, the locked-container break event, and an eleven-module exact-version handshake.

gallery.title: Totem ecosystem integration
gallery.description: The shared Core contracts and eleven-module DeadRecall 2.4.11 integration map.

modules.title: TotemRemnant
modules.description: Tiered modular backpacks, death-item recovery, soulbound retention, and portable-container safety for Fabric survival.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemRemnant 0.2.11 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Makes the inventory-side backpack panel interactive, adds guided manual progression, and automatically scans eligible soulbound teleport interfaces at death without prior travel.

gallery.title: Backpack inventory panel
gallery.description: The carried backpack appears beside the vanilla inventory with server-authoritative item interaction.

gallery.title: Backpack upgrade bay
gallery.description: The one-row module bay and integrated 3 by 3 crafting area.

gallery.title: Capacity upgrades
gallery.description: Four capacity modules expand a backpack with four additional storage rows.

modules.title: TotemAutomata
modules.description: Give Copper Golems server-authoritative sorting and gathering jobs with tools, fuel, storage routes, and configurable targets.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemAutomata 0.1.12 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds guided manual progression and optional TotemLocksmith authorization for persisted Copper Golem operators while retaining bounded sorting and gathering.

modules.title: TotemNexus
modules.description: Build material-driven Space Units for lodestone travel, maps, friends, safe routes, and optional death recovery.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemNexus 0.2.6 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds guided manual progression, a read-only mutual-friendship API, and resolver-valid death-time soulbound eligibility without requiring prior teleport use.

gallery.title: Space Unit materials
gallery.description: Material-driven capacity, stability, route, and cross-dimensional travel diagnostics.

modules.title: TotemDiscordBridge
modules.description: Relay chat, player activity, server events, attachments, audits, and live status to Discord through a configurable HTTPS Worker.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemDiscordBridge 0.1.6 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds deduplicated TotemLocksmith non-owner break alerts and bounded event-ID retention while preserving existing chat, lifecycle, audit, attachment, and status relays.

modules.title: TotemAlchemy
modules.description: Turn cauldrons and brewing stands into dynamic alchemy with discoverable ingredients, multiple outcomes, and custom brews.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemAlchemy 0.1.23 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds guided source-block and manual acquisition advancements while retaining heated cauldrons, dynamic brewing, discoveries, ingredients, and custom potion families.

gallery.title: Alchemy ingredients
gallery.description: Alchemy ingredients, vessels, and custom brews available in DeadRecall 2.4.11.

modules.title: TotemEnchanting
modules.description: Make Chiseled Bookshelves contribute content-based enchanting power, scaling beyond vanilla with clear particle feedback.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemEnchanting 0.1.5 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds gated source-block and method-manual progression while retaining content-based Chiseled Bookshelf power up to 64 and visual feedback.

modules.title: Totem Excavation
modules.description: Mine controlled areas with seven tiers of server-authoritative hammers and reusable per-stack selection rules.
modules.changelog: Standalone Totem Excavation 0.1.2 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds gated source-block and method-manual progression while retaining seven hammer tiers, per-stack selections, bounded server-side mining, and local outlines.

modules.title: Totem Locksmith
modules.description: Protect fixed Hopper-connected storage networks with one Padlock, server-owned permissions, physical keys, and optional Discord alerts.
modules.changelog: Initial Totem Locksmith 0.1.0 release from DeadRecall 2.4.11. One Padlock protects a fixed-Hopper storage network; root-side split semantics, persisted ACLs and keys, automation policy, placement and explosion protection, non-owner break audits, and optional Nexus, Automata, and DiscordBridge integrations are server-authoritative.

modules.title: TotemVanillaTweaks
modules.description: Focused Fabric improvements for container sorting, recipes, bookshelf rules, concrete hardening, and furnace experience.
modules.changelog: Standalone TotemVanillaTweaks 0.1.8 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds gated source-block and method-manual progression while retaining server-validated sorting, Lecterns, Bookshelf rules, concrete hardening, and furnace experience recovery.

modules.title: Totem Villagers
modules.description: A server-authoritative village economy where villagers carry real stock, work, craft, trade, build, and manage resources.
modules.changelog: Standalone Totem Villagers 0.1.23 from DeadRecall 2.4.11. Adds gated source-block and method-manual progression while retaining physical stock, profession production, protected work inventories, builders, guards, work zones, and mangrove villages.

gallery.title: Mangrove village
gallery.description: A terrain-aware generated mangrove village with integrated production areas.
